original-johto.flavorText: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.

hoenn.flavorText: A QUAGSIRE hunts by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in. Because it doesn’t move, it does not get very hungry.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: A dim-witted Pokémon. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head into boats or rocks while swimming.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

updated-johto.flavorText: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

original-unova.flavorText: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

updated-unova.flavorText: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

kalos.flavorText: This carefree Pokémon has an easygoing nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.
